newsitem.title: CHINA: Cook confesses to murder of China novelist.
newsitem.headline: Cook confesses to murder of China novelist.

text.p: A chef from central China has confessed to murdering a famous Chinese novelist and her niece and robbing them of money and valuables, official media reported on Wednesday.
Dai Houying, 58, and her 19-year-old niece were murdered on August 25 at Dai's apartment in the grounds of Fudan university in Shanghai.
A special team of more than 100 police were assigned to the case and interviewed nearly 2,000 friends and associates of Dai, the Xinmin Evening News said.

Their inquiries led them to a hotel in Jieshou in the northern part of the central province of Anhui where on Sunday they arrested a chef called Tao Feng and found Dai's bank account book in the hotel, it said.

Tao was a grandson of a middle school teacher of Dai, Xinhua news agency said. He confessed to stabbing Dai and her niece with a knife and taking her savings deposit book, watches and jewellery before escaping to a restaurant in Jieshou, it added.
Police confiscated most of the items Tao had taken from Dai's home and brought him to Shanghai on Tuesday, it said.
Dai was a professor at the Literature Institute of Shanghai University.
